title: .orca-test-runner.json
description: Which tests the Test Runner plugin for Orca runs in this workspace.

autoRunScope.description: What runs after an agent finishes: only tests related to the changed files (Vitest, Jest), or every test.

ignore.description: Folders to leave out of detection. Ignored when "projects" is given.

projects.description: The projects to run, instead of detecting them.

name.description: Shown in the panel. Defaults to the package name.

root.description: Folder relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the root.

runner.description: Detected in the folder when left out.

autoRun.description: Run after an agent finishes. Defaults to true, false for Playwright and Cypress.
